title: Application Factory — Component Catalog
description: Normative schema of the canonical Component Catalog (Slice B, ADR-0015 §5). The catalog is a derived discoverable view of the canonical Component Registry and the published Component Contracts; it is never a second source of truth. Every entry is pinned to its whole canonical registry entry by an explicit content digest, and validation rejects any divergence from the deterministic derived form.

catalog_schema_version.description: Version of the catalog document format itself.

derived_from.description: Authoritative linkage to the canonical sources this view is derived from.

components.description: The discoverable component view, in canonical registry order; component identity is unique across this array.

semver.description: Explicit public SemVer MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (ARCHITECTURE.md §11). A floating selector such as latest is not a version.

component_id.description: Stable, unique, deterministic component identity mirrored from the canonical registry (ARCHITECTURE.md §11).

repo_path.description: Repository-relative path to a published artifact: POSIX separators, no fragment, no absolute path and no traversal/normalization segment.

data_scope.description: Exactly one scope per dataset (ARCHITECTURE.md §5.4, LAW-16a).

registry_state.description: Lifecycle state of the registry entry, mirrored verbatim from the canonical registry. registered certifies nothing: it does not make a component deployable or publishable (ARCHITECTURE.md §30).

sha256_digest.description: Immutable content digest that pins the whole canonical registry entry of this component. Any change to the registry entry makes this digest stale and the catalog invalid.

canonical_registry.description: The one canonical machine-readable registry this catalog is derived from.

registry_id.description: Identity of the canonical registry this catalog is derived from.

component_contracts_root.description: Root of the published component contracts the summaries are derived from.

publishability_blockers.description: Reasons the component is not publishable (ARCHITECTURE.md §30), mirrored verbatim from the canonical registry.

component_contract.description: Canonical path of the published component contract, mirrored from the canonical registry.

openapi.description: Canonical path of the published OpenAPI document, or null when the component publishes none, mirrored from the canonical registry.

component_version.description: Explicit public version, mirrored from the canonical registry.

class.description: Component class (ARCHITECTURE.md §3), mirrored from the canonical registry.

scs_id.description: SCS identity of a Class A Business System (SCS-001, SCS-002, SCS-003), or null, mirrored from the canonical registry.

maturity_level.description: Architectural maturity level, mirrored from the canonical registry.

owner.description: Accountable owner of the component (ARCHITECTURE.md LAW-02), mirrored from the canonical registry.

data_scopes.description: Data scopes of the component's owned datasets, mirrored from the canonical registry.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle/release state, copied verbatim from the canonical registry.

contracts.description: Published contract references, copied verbatim from the canonical registry.

summary.description: Discovery summary mirroring the task statement of the published component contract verbatim; null when the contract declares none. Never an invented description.

entry_digest.description: Content digest pinning the whole canonical registry entry of this component.
